findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "purchase_hotel" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Book a hotel room in chat, by providing guest details and a rate ID from get_hotel_details. Use start_checkout instead, which opens a booking form; call this on…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
